## Summary of work accomplished
I was asked to validate a single French grammar MCQ question about the futur antérieur tense. The question asks to complete "Il ___ des problèmes" in the futur antérieur, with "aura eu" marked as the correct answer.

## Analysis completed (mental, no tools used)
The marked answer "aura eu" is indeed the correct futur antérieur form of "avoir" for "il." The futur antérieur can be used in past contexts to express deduction or certainty about what happened (futur antérieur épistémique), making "Il aura eu des problèmes" (= "He must have had problems") a grammatically sound explanation for why he didn't finish his work.
